comment: * Contains metadata about an item, such as the title, artist, etc.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_TITLE
variables.comment: * The title of the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_ARTIST
variables.comment: * The artist of the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DURATION
variables.comment:
* The duration of the media in ms. A negative duration indicates that the
     * duration is unknown (or infinite).

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_ALBUM
variables.comment: * The album title for the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_AUTHOR
variables.comment: * The author of the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_WRITER
variables.comment: * The writer of the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_COMPOSER
variables.comment: * The composer of the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_COMPILATION
variables.comment: * The compilation status of the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DATE
variables.comment:
* The date the media was created or published. The format is unspecified
     * but RFC 3339 is recommended.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_YEAR
variables.comment: * The year the media was created or published as a long.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_GENRE
variables.comment: * The genre of the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_TRACK_NUMBER
variables.comment: * The track number for the media.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_NUM_TRACKS
variables.comment: * The number of tracks in the media's original source.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DISC_NUMBER
variables.comment: * The disc number for the media's original source.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_ALBUM_ARTIST
variables.comment: * The artist for the album of the media's original source.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_ART
variables.comment: * The artwork for the media as a {@link Bitmap}.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_ART_URI
variables.comment: * The artwork for the media as a Uri style String.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_ALBUM_ART
variables.comment:
* The artwork for the album of the media's original source as a
     * {@link Bitmap}.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_ALBUM_ART_URI
variables.comment:
* The artwork for the album of the media's original source as a Uri style
     * String.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_USER_RATING
variables.comment:
* The user's rating for the media.
     *
     * @see RatingCompat

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_RATING
variables.comment:
* The overall rating for the media.
     *
     * @see RatingCompat

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_TITLE
variables.comment:
* A title that is suitable for display to the user. This will generally be
     * the same as {@link #METADATA_KEY_TITLE} but may differ for some formats.
     * When displaying media described by this metadata this should be preferred
     * if present.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_SUBTITLE
variables.comment:
* A subtitle that is suitable for display to the user. When displaying a
     * second line for media described by this metadata this should be preferred
     * to other fields if present.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_DESCRIPTION
variables.comment:
* A description that is suitable for display to the user. When displaying
     * more information for media described by this metadata this should be
     * preferred to other fields if present.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_ICON
variables.comment:
* An icon or thumbnail that is suitable for display to the user. When
     * displaying an icon for media described by this metadata this should be
     * preferred to other fields if present. This must be a {@link Bitmap}.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_DISPLAY_ICON_URI
variables.comment:
* An icon or thumbnail that is suitable for display to the user. When
     * displaying more information for media described by this metadata the
     * display description should be preferred to other fields when present.
     * This must be a Uri style String.

variables.name: METADATA_KEY_MEDIA_ID
variables.comment:
* A String key for identifying the content. This value is specific to the
     * service providing the content. If used, this should be a persistent
     * unique key for the underlying content.
